associations.probe_take: Bounded alphabet is not the blocker by itself. The real question is whether the boundary code is a sufficient statistic for exact arithmetic composition across levels.
If distinct phases of cancellation are not explicitly encoded in the bounded state alphabet, the missing information will reappear as hidden extractor logic.

expansion: no asymptotic escape without new effective relations
associations.probe_take: With X frozen, a level-2 win has to come from boundary reuse, defect routing, or better seed economics, not from discovering a genuinely richer slope alphabet.
The corridor only helps if the short dimension does real computational work. If it behaves like a boundary-programmed 1D strip, H1 will flatten quickly.
The only meaningful H1 signal is that level-2 exact extraction improves under the same interface schema, the same X, and the same accounting rules.
Any scale-specific merge rule, rescue SAT pass, or level-2-only linear solve should be treated as a failed concept probe, even if the final certificate is legal.

Most attractive local rules are easier to explain as affine or eventually periodic compressions than as new certificate machinery. The probe should assume collapse until a concrete non-affine interface mechanism survives audit.
If the frontier survives only because the CA gets a better extractor, more search budget, or a looser symmetry quotient, there is no concept-level gain.
A promising macrocell boundary type is not occupancy. It is a tiny typed summary of unresolved arithmetic obligations, plus the phase information needed to compose them without backtracking.

forced_bridges.mechanism: Treat each macrocell boundary as a cooperative glue handshake that exports a finite residue summary. If single-sided attachment is enough, the interface is probably too weak to beat direct search.

View the thin corridor cross-section as a channel with finite cut capacity. The number of distinguishable interface traces is a hard upper bound on how much unresolved arithmetic state can pass between scales.
A macrocell interface should behave like a bounded-width cut formula. If eliminating that cut forces a proof-width blow-up at level 2, the grammar is hiding global repair.

forced_bridges.from: fixed X but nontrivial global structure
forced_bridges.to: computable tilings and quasicrystal local rules
forced_bridges.mechanism: Use phase-coded aperiodicity to organize repeated uses of the same X without introducing new slopes. The promise is geometric nonperiodicity, not alphabet growth.
Reinterpret local updates as oriented defect transport toward sinks. The hoped-for gain is fewer boundary seeds because cancellation defects are moved and discharged rather than repeatedly recreated.

forced_bridges.to: abelian distributed processors and CRDT-style convergence
forced_bridges.mechanism: Demand order-independent local discharge at the macrocell level. If composition depends on update order, then the interface is not a true certificate primitive.

The only legitimate CA advantage is reusable description length that survives exact extraction. If the same compressed family is findable by direct grammar search with the same budget, the CA is just a proposal heuristic.

anomaly_results.constraint: Force the corridor height to 1, or make the cross-section dynamically passive.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: Level-2 transfer should flatten or worsen because the system becomes effectively 1D and relies almost entirely on boundary programming.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: A positive result here would be suspiciously close to hidden global logic rather than genuine local composition.

anomaly_results.constraint: Export only occupancy counts or seed counts at interfaces, with no signed residue summary.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: Level-2 exact extraction will likely require a fresh global linear solve to reconcile cross-boundary cancellations.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: This directly tests whether the interface is a sufficient statistic or merely a lossy sketch.

anomaly_results.constraint: Make the bulk update affine and allow nonlinearity only at explicit interface gates.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: If any improvement survives, the real lever is auditable interface gating; if performance collapses, the model was relying on diffuse nonlinear repair hidden in the interior.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: This is the cleanest way to use affine-CA limitations as an architecture audit rather than a metaphor.

anomaly_results.constraint: Replace the CA rollout inside each macrocell with exact local elimination while keeping the same interface alphabet.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: If the extracted level-2 family stays the same, the CA is only a search prior; if it changes, the state alphabet was failing to carry enough arithmetic information.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: This separates dynamical storytelling from true compositional content.

anomaly_results.constraint: Double interface width while keeping the internal rule and X fixed.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: A sudden improvement would indicate a bandwidth bottleneck rather than a new arithmetic mechanism.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: This is the fastest way to tell whether the corridor is starved for cross-scale information.

anomaly_results.constraint: Randomize stage order at each recursive level while preserving the same local rule table.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: A fragile boundary-programmed construction should collapse quickly, while a real interface algebra should degrade more gracefully.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: Stage-order robustness is one of the cheapest anti-overfitting checks in the current benchmark design.

anomaly_results.constraint: Remove all seeds except two corner defects and one typed boundary sink.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: If defect transport is the real lever, some anisotropic families should still scale; if performance dies immediately, the route was only heavy boundary seeding.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: This distinguishes transport from mere initialization budget.

anomaly_results.constraint: Transpose the corridor so the long and short axes swap roles, but keep the same rule family.
anomaly_results.expected_effect: A real oriented-transport mechanism may weaken but should remain interpretable; a geometry-specific artifact will usually invert or disappear entirely.
anomaly_results.why_it_matters: It checks whether the claimed gain is a transport law or just a one-axis encoding trick.

steering_directions.rationale: The strongest rescue path for H1 is a finite interface that is a sufficient statistic for exact composition. The self-assembly and intrinsic-universality literature suggests that real compositional power appears when interfaces require typed, cooperative handshakes rather than single-channel occupancy.
steering_directions.first_step: Define a tiny interface alphabet carrying a signed residue basis over fixed X, a phase bit, and a seed-debt counter; then SAT-check pairwise and 2x2 macrocell compositions under one unchanging extractor.
steering_directions.expected_signal: The same interface table parses level-1 and level-2 exact certificates, and level-2 lowers R faster than it increases m on the matched corridor.

steering_directions.rationale: The self-describing-circuits and strict-self-assembly line gives a concrete warning: if directional bandwidth is insufficient, recursive generators drift into periodic large patches. Thin corridors are especially vulnerable to this failure mode.
steering_directions.first_step: For a frozen grammar, count the number of distinguishable legal interface traces as macro-width grows, and compare that to the number of distinct unresolved residue classes seen in exact level-1 extraction.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Promising families show a nontrivial growth of interface distinguishability; dead families hit a tiny periodic trace set before level-2 helps.

steering_directions.rationale: Simulation Limitations of Affine Cellular Automata makes a broad affine interior a likely dead end. If H1 works, its nonlinearity should be concentrated in a small, auditable shell rather than smeared across the whole rule table.
steering_directions.first_step: Symbolically classify each local update into affine and non-affine pieces, then restrict nonlinearity to interface threshold gates and compare exact extraction against the unrestricted rule family.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Either the gain survives and the true mechanism becomes transparent, or the whole route reveals itself as hidden nonlinear repair.

steering_directions.rationale: The sweep-rule decoder literature offers a rare local mechanism with credible local-to-global behavior: oriented defect motion toward sinks. That is more promising than generic monotone growth for reducing seeds without changing X.
steering_directions.first_step: Design height-2 and height-3 corridor rules with typed defects, one oriented sink, and an exact local invariant over X; then compare level-1 and level-2 extracted scores against isotropic and direct no-CA controls.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Level-2 keeps the same interface schema yet reduces boundary seed demand enough to offset the extra edges introduced by recursion.

steering_directions.rationale: Abelian networks are not the main bridge, but their least-action and order-independence viewpoint is well matched to the no-repair requirement. It is a useful screening device for interface families that ought to compose cleanly.
steering_directions.first_step: Attach a tiny production matrix or discharge signature to each level-1 macrocell type and test whether those signatures correlate with level-2 exact transfer under the same geometry and X.
steering_directions.expected_signal: Families with commuting discharge compose without repair noticeably more often than arithmetic-feature-matched controls.

steering_directions.rationale: With X fixed, the cleanest way to escape the trivial periodic basin is not to add slopes but to add geometric phase structure. The computable-tilings literature shows finite local rules can enforce nonperiodic global organization without enlarging the alphabet of tile types.
steering_directions.first_step: Impose a tiny aperiodic phase schedule on corridor cross-sections or stage order, and keep only rule families whose extracted interfaces remain recognisable and closed under the same composition law.
steering_directions.expected_signal: The extracted level-2 families stop looking like tensor powers or ultimately periodic strips, yet still use the same X and the same interface alphabet.

checks: Extract level-1 and level-2 with exactly the same parser, interface schema, and symmetry quotient.
Replace the CA rollout with exhaustive direct composition over interface types; the extracted certificate must be identical.
Benchmark against direct no-CA search on the same corridor, same X, same rule-description budget, and same optimizer budget.
validation_checks.pass_signal: Level-2 exact score improves and no new scale-specific interface or repair rule appears.
validation_checks.kill_signal: Any new global merge rule, rescue SAT pass, or level-2-only interface symbol is needed.

checks: Measure the growth of distinct legal interface traces under canonicalization as corridor width increases.
Compare that growth to the number of residue-summary classes produced by exact level-1 extraction.
Run the same count on transposed and isotropic controls.
validation_checks.pass_signal: Interface distinguishability grows enough to plausibly carry unresolved arithmetic state across scales.
validation_checks.kill_signal: The trace language becomes constant-size or quickly periodic before any level-2 gain appears.

checks: Classify every local rule component as affine or non-affine over the chosen coefficient field.
Ablate to an affine interior plus explicit nonlinear interface gates and repeat exact extraction.
Track whether the same families still win after the ablation under matched baselines.
validation_checks.pass_signal: A small auditable nonlinear shell explains the gain.
validation_checks.kill_signal: Performance depends on diffuse nonlinearity spread through the bulk, with no clean interface interpretation.

checks: Verify an exact local invariant for each sweep step over fixed X.
Compare anisotropic, isotropic, and orientation-randomized versions on the same corridor family.
Remove extra boundary seeds and check whether the transport mechanism still reduces R at level 2.
validation_checks.pass_signal: An oriented transport law survives the controls and the level-2 score improves through lower seed cost, not just more edges.
validation_checks.kill_signal: The gain disappears when orientation is perturbed or when boundary seeding is reduced.

checks: Compute a production-matrix or discharge signature for each level-1 macrocell type.
Test whether those signatures predict successful level-2 transfer better than direct arithmetic descriptors such as rank, support size, and edge density.
Confirm that compositions with the same signature are update-order independent.
validation_checks.pass_signal: The abelian screen adds predictive power beyond simple arithmetic features and filters out many failed compositions.
validation_checks.kill_signal: The signatures are decorative: they correlate with halting or order-independence but not with low exact score.

checks: Canonicalize away trivial symmetries and test whether distinct phase classes still survive extraction.
Compare against periodic, random-phase, and direct no-CA controls at the same X and grammar budget.
Audit the extracted families for eventual periodicity, tensor-power behavior, and low-rational-complexity residues.
validation_checks.pass_signal: Nonperiodic phase structure survives exact extraction and produces a level-2 frontier that periodic controls do not match.
validation_checks.kill_signal: After extraction the family is still periodic, tensor-like, or obviously trapped in the same low-rational-complexity basin.

sub_problem: Can a fixed finite corridor-substitution cellular-automaton grammar with bounded state alphabet and fixed X produce level-2 exact score improvement over matched direct no-CA baselines without bespoke global repair or collapse into the bounded-slope / low-rational-complexity basin?
